sources.title: Qwen2.5-7B QLoRA Fine-tuning Guide - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository provides a complete, production-ready implementation for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-7B using QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation). QLoRA enables efficient fine-tuning of large language models on consumer-grade GPUs by using 4-bit quantization.

sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: How to Fine-Tune Qwen2.5-7B on a 16GB GPU Using QLoRA
sources.snippet: Learn how to use QLoRA to shrink a 7B parameter model from 15GB to 5.4GB, enabling fine-tuning on consumer-grade 16GB GPUs like the NVIDIA T4.
